# SQLite

The SQLite shell in `tests/a64/cli/bin/sqlite3` is built by
`tests/a64/cli/build.sh` from the SQLite amalgamation 3.47.2
(`sqlite-amalgamation-3470200.zip`, pinned by SHA-256). SQLite is in the
public domain: its authors disclaim copyright to the source code, as the
header of every source file of the amalgamation says.
